Plot longitudinal and paired-sample microbiome data

Source: R/mp_longitudinal.R
mp_longitudinal.Rd

Visualises time-course or before/after designs: per-subject diversity trajectories (spaghetti), ordination trajectories connecting paired timepoints, alluvial flows of taxonomic shifts, and small-multiple "horizon" area bands of taxon dynamics.

Usage

mp_longitudinal(
  object,
  time.var,
  subject.var,
  plot.type = c("spaghetti", "trajectory", "alluvial", "horizon"),
  group.by = NULL,
  measure = "Shannon",
  tax.level = "Phylum",
  top.n = 8,
  distance = "bray",
  smooth = TRUE,
  palette = NULL,
  theme = NULL,
  plot.title = NULL,
  plot.subtitle = NULL,
  plot.caption = NULL,
  font.size = getOption("micropubr.font.size", 11),
  interactive = FALSE,
  verbose = getOption("micropubr.verbose", FALSE)
)

Arguments

object

A phyloseq::phyloseq object.

time.var

Metadata column giving the timepoint (numeric or ordered).

subject.var

Metadata column identifying the subject / individual.

plot.type

One of "spaghetti", "trajectory", "alluvial" or "horizon".

group.by

Optional metadata column for colouring (e.g. treatment arm).

measure

Alpha-diversity index for "spaghetti" plots.

tax.level

Taxonomic rank for "alluvial" / "horizon" plots.

top.n

Number of taxa to display in "alluvial" / "horizon".

distance

Distance metric for "trajectory" ordination.

smooth

Add a per-group LOESS smooth to "spaghetti" plots.

palette

Palette name or colour vector.

theme

A ggplot2 theme; defaults to mp_theme_publication().

plot.title, plot.subtitle, plot.caption

Optional labels.

font.size

Base font size.

interactive

If TRUE, return an interactive plotly widget instead of a static ggplot (requires plotly). See mp_alpha().

verbose

Print the steps used.

Value

A ggplot object, or a plotly widget when interactive = TRUE.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
mp_longitudinal(ps, time.var = "Week", subject.var = "SubjectID",
                group.by = "Arm", measure = "Shannon")
} # }
